all_words.explanation: 'River bank' (nehir kıyısı) is a natural collocation in which 'bank' refers to the edge of a river.
Veznedar (teller) is a person who works in a bank, so there is a direct meaning link.
Dağ (mountain) has no semantic or usage connection with 'bank' in either of its meanings.
Kredi (loan) is one of the core services of a bank, so the two words share a topic.
Yastığın (pillow) bankayla hiçbir anlam ya da kullanım bağı yoktur.
Çek (cheque) is a payment instrument used in banking, so it is closely linked in meaning.

explanation: 'Bank' hem para kurumu hem de nehir kıyısı anlamına gelir; ilişkili kelimeler bu iki anlamdan birine bağlanır, ilgisiz olanlar ise hiçbirine bağlanmaz.
